about_the_game:
This adorable space cat has been tasked with taking the last surviving plant to the moon in hopes of inhabiting it. But the ship is breaking down the more it flies on!

The power generators keep breaking, all the defense turrets have mistakenly marked YOU as their target, and the plant can't sustain itself.

Will you join them in their quest and succeed? Or will you falter?

Gameplay Overview

Hydropawnics is a 3D isometric puzzle platformer all about managing your time and resources effectively. Generators will break and need to be fixed, the sole plant slowly deteriorates with water, and the turrets will fire at you from many angles.

As you progress, the map and challenges needed to progress get harder, so you will need to think more carefully about how to do your job well. Your quick thinking, platforming, and management skills will all be necessary to come out on top!

Hydropawnics was initially created as part of a student game jam by 5 developers. Hope you have fun with it!
